Hi Anika / AP team —

Following up on invoice INV-3917 (attached). Procurement flagged the VAT line: the invoice currently shows a reverse-charge note that your tax team said should not appear on your PO. To avoid AP delays we can: 

- Reissue the invoice w/ the VAT line removed (same amount), or
